topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, it seems the good lord above has shifted the winds again, and young Will has been called to the mill. We'll miss his strong back in the fields, but the grain won't grind itself, now will it? I've said a prayer for his path, that the change brings him closer to the life he dreams of. His smile brightened these acres, and I hope the mill sees much of that light. We've already started to mend the hoe he left behind, so the next pair of hands can care for the crops just as he did. The saints, they watch over us all, don’t they?
